info.title: Svemir Verdict Oracle
info.description: x402 payment-gated verdict oracle. Accepts x402 exact payments on Base (EIP-3009 USDC) and Solana (SPL USDC), then returns a policy verdict over a payment receipt.

get.summary: Free health probe (service version, active networks, price).
Free x402 discovery: returns the 402 challenge with pricing and accepted networks.

402.description: Payment required. Body is the x402 challenge; `accepts` lists Base and Solana exact schemes.

post.summary: Paid endpoint. Settles the X-PAYMENT (0.01 USDC, Base or Solana), then returns a verdict over the POST body receipt — or over the settled payment itself when no body is sent.

parameters.name: X-PAYMENT
parameters.description: Base64 JSON x402 payment: { x402Version: 1, scheme: 'exact', network: 'base'|'solana', payload }.

txHash.description: Transaction hash of the third-party payment to judge.

iznos.description: Expected amount (token base units, as string).

nonce.description: EIP-3009 nonce, if the receipt uses TransferWithAuthorization.

200.description: Payment settled; verdict returned. `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header carries the base64 receipt.

402.description: Payment required; x402 challenge with Base and Solana accepts.

429.description: Rate limit: 12 paid attempts per minute per IP.
